sources.title: IndexTTS — TTS Model
sources.snippet: IndexTTS is a GPT-style, industrial-grade zero-shot TTS from Bilibili with strong Chinese and English support. It adds controllable pronunciation through pinyin correction and punctuation-based pausing.
